changelog: Signing in with an address that has never been used now works: /login/email only signs in existing accounts, so a new address failed with an account error after the code was accepted.

The email step asks the backend whether the address is registered and sends the code with the matching intent; an unknown address is registered in the background once the code checks out, then signed straight in.
The self-registered account is the email's local part (suffixed if taken) with the password set to that account plus 1234.
